_help: Daily autopilot (daily.py). slots: publish times in order. kind: carousel (news) or reel. concept guide = the 07:30 guide Reel (D-31), made first in its own stage and uploaded on its own (D-40). guide_reel: make the guide Reel every morning. tool_reels: Product Hunt tool Reels for the other Reel slots; a tool with no real product screen is skipped (D-38). D-40 (user 2026-10-22): all five slots back; the causes of the rejections are fixed instead of fewer slots.
_publish_lag_help: D-56 (user 2026-11-03): a run makes the NEXT day's posts; the morning yükle schedules what the day before made and keeps the new run for tomorrow. 0 = the old same-day flow.
_guide_carousel_help: D-72 (user 2026-11-12: "D onay veriyorum olsun"): the 18:00 carousel slot with concept guide is a saveable guide carousel (a known AI product's feature, step by step); if none is made, a news carousel fills it.
